title: RISE Germany
field: Biology, chemistry, computer science, physics, earth sciences, engineering
about: DAAD RISE Germany 2027: three-month summer research internships at German universities and institutes for undergraduates from North American, British and Irish universities in sciences and engineering. Internships start between 15 May and 15 July 2027; reference letters due 15 December 2026.
requirements: Enrolled in a bachelor's programme at a North American, British or Irish university
Field: biology, chemistry, computer science, physics, earth sciences, engineering or closely related

why: "Field: biology, chemistry, computer science, physics, earth sciences, engineering or closely related" → "Scientific discovery: protein folding (AlphaFold), materials science, climate modelling"
